build_blip_nlvr_model: build a BLIP NLVR model with vision and multimodal backbones for natural language visual reasoning
predict_blip_nlvr: predict NLVR labels by running image pairs and text through the BlipNLVR model forward pass
loss_blip_nlvr: calculate cross-entropy loss for NLVR training by comparing model outputs against ground truth labels
preprocess_text_blip_nlvr: preprocess and tokenize text samples from data samples using the built-in tokenizer with padding and truncation
forward_blip_nlvr: run the unified forward pass in loss or predict mode for BLIP NLVR image-text pairs
